traceability.notes: Story 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION is fully implemented. The ESLint rule `valid-story-reference`, its supporting utilities, and helpers implement all specified requirements: they resolve and validate @story paths against configured story directories and project boundaries, enforce .story.md by default (with configurable relaxation), prevent traversal and disallowed absolute paths, cache filesystem checks, and provide clear diagnostics for missing files, invalid extensions, invalid paths, and filesystem errors. Comprehensive Jest tests specifically tied to this story verify core functionality, configuration options, boundary behavior, and robust error handling. Documentation in docs/rules/valid-story-reference.md matches the story specification, including path resolution rules and examples. All related tests pass, so the story is assessed as PASSED.
